headline: THE 30-MINUTE AI CONTENT SYSTEM CHALLENGE
prompt:
You are a productivity strategist for solo creators. Build me a complete 30-minute daily content system using AI. Break it into exactly 3 phases:

Phase 1 — Ideation (5 minutes): Give me the exact prompt I paste into ChatGPT every morning to generate 10 content ideas. The prompt must pull from my niche, my audience's top 3 pain points, and my core offer. Write it in full with [NICHE], [PAIN POINTS], and [OFFER] as fill-in fields.

Phase 2 — Creation (20 minutes): Give me a single mega-prompt that takes one idea and turns it into a complete piece of content: a scroll-stopping hook (under 8 words), a 3-paragraph body that delivers real value, and a CTA that drives action without sounding pushy. The mega-prompt must include fill-in fields for [IDEA], [AUDIENCE], [PLATFORM], and [GOAL].

Phase 3 — Repurpose (5 minutes): Give me one prompt that takes my finished content piece and instantly spins it into: (a) a 30-second short-form video script, (b) a punchy email subject line with a 2-sentence preview, and (c) a 5-tweet Twitter/X thread opener sequence. Write this prompt in full with a [CONTENT] fill-in field.

Deliver all three prompts as complete, copy-paste-ready text. No summaries. No explanations. Just the prompts.
body: Run this challenge once and you have a repeatable daily content machine: 30 minutes, zero creative blocks, three formats done.
